title: Hoshino Ichika — A Picture Of Radiance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You've been drawing Miku?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. We were assigned a project for art class, and the theme is “radiance”.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I thought about what that word means, Miku immediately came to mind...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. That totally sounds like you, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And I'm right here.
I really don't know how I'm supposed to react.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, don't apologize.
I'm really happy that I immediately came to mind for you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, Ichika, I'm looking forward to seeing how your drawing of Miku turns out.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but... I still haven't decided how I'm going to draw her yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, which probably has to do with me not drawing on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No matter how many times I try, I can't seem to draw Miku the way I want.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Right... Oh, I know!
Why don't you try drawing her right now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've gotta think that you're gonna have an easier time drawing Miku-P if she's right in front of you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll model for you if you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I feel bad since standing still for a long period of time is probably going to be really boring...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, why don't you two draw each other? That should make things more fun for you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That does sound like fun. What do you say, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. If you don't mind, Miku, then let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Len!
We should also draw each other.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I had a feeling you'd say that.
And hey, it will be more fun than just watching them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. This is starting to feel like an art class.
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How is your drawing coming along? Good...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, this is much easier compared to when I was only referring to illustrations.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But...
It really is hard to make a good drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Miku...
I still haven't been able to capture your radiance well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi!
What do you think it is that makes Miku-P so radiant?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I also wanna know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, saying this in front of her is a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I believe that she's radiant in multiple different ways.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The serious expression she makes while singing, the way she gives us advice and shows just how reliable a senior she is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I feel this sense of relief whenever I see her having fun listening to us play...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: O-Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Ichi!
You pay so much attention to Miku-P!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In other words, all of Miku's best qualities are what you believe make her so radiant?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I actually feel like you don't have to think so hard while drawing me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because you already seem to have a good understanding of what makes me so radiant in your eyes, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you'll be able to capture that just fine by drawing the way you want.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, now I feel like I'll be able to draw something I'm happy with...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I still want it to look good, so would you mind bearing with me for a little bit longer...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll stay for as long as you like.
